mcp_default_prompt.description: Use the MCP dispatcher with list_servers to find available servers, list_tools to discover tools, get_tool_details to retrieve all available details for a tool, and execute_tool to run it. get_tool_details returns the input schema and any title, description, output schema, MCP annotations, and task-support status supplied by the server; unavailable details are omitted. Use the server_id and tool name provided in this context or returned by discovery. Tools already described in this context do not need to be discovered again and will not appear in discovery results.

data_description.disabled_tools: The list of tools that are available to the AI when performing on-demand tool discovery.
data_description.tool_name_pattern: Full match regular expression to filter tools during on-demand discovery. Any tools that match this regex will be unavailable and hidden from the AI agent during on demand discovery. Leave empty for no regular-expression restriction.
data_description.regex_timeout: Maximum seconds allowed for each hard-filter regular-expression match before it returns no results.
